newsitem.title: USA: TI to launch digital signal microprocessor.
newsitem.headline: TI to launch digital signal microprocessor.

text.p: Texas Instruments Inc said Monday it was preparing to launch a digital signal microprocessor that would control the motors in consumer products like dishwashers, washing machines and automobiles.
Texas Instrument said it planned to work with applicance and automobile manufacturers to design the microprocessor for the systems in their products in 1997.
The chip could enter the market in 1998, it added.
Texas said the microprocessor was designed to do advanced motor control functions like power steering and hydraulics in automobiles.
It also said the microprocessor eliminated mechanical parts, making it possible for applicances and other products to become smaller, cheaper, quieter and more energy efficient.
Texas said the microprocessor is already being used in modems, hard-disk drives and cellular phones.
